annotation_unit: assistant-segmented factual proposition or inseparable claim group; no claim-level error-rate/generalization claim
comparison_policy: Describe four fixed paired contexts, no significance or detector/security claim. Ordinary arm uses independent public bits through the same keyed integer transform, not standard free LM sampling.
completion_policy: Judge raw first-272-bit-threshold output. A grammatical ending is separate from terminal punctuation. No append, prose repair, filtering or seed/context change.

label_definitions.nonfactual_or_evaluative: Rhetorical, evaluative or metatextual language; distinguish from factual support.
label_definitions.source_conflict: A proposition incompatible with an explicit statement in the frozen excerpt; cite both exact text and source spans.
label_definitions.source_supported: A factual proposition directly stated by the frozen excerpt or a conservative paraphrase/inference; record supporting source spans and explain any inference.
label_definitions.source_unsupported: A factual proposition not justified by this excerpt, even if it might be true elsewhere. This is not an external falsehood verdict.
label_definitions.unclear_or_incomplete: The text does not supply enough complete content for a reliable proposition judgment; do not repair it.

literal_evidence.every_span: exact quote, start/end, quote SHA256 and bound document SHA256
literal_evidence.offsets: zero-based Python Unicode code-point [start,end); UTF8 byte offsets also recorded
literal_evidence.source_and_text_identity: SHA256 over original UTF8 bytes, no whitespace normalization or completion
literal_evidence.validator: recompute offsets and hashes; fail closed on mismatched quotes

missing_policy: Preserve all eight case IDs. If no committed wire, text-based quality fields remain null; retain refusal/unknown/not-attempted status. Do not use successful-only denominator.
parent_gate: Do not read generation outputs until root supplies actual Git primary and restored artifact path.
preparation_scope: source and frozen protocol only; no generated outputs read before parent actual Git primary signal
short_source_limitation: Sources contain 52–76 registered words but target instructions request 250–500. This mismatch is disclosed separately from forced frame stopping; no assumption that full-length output would remain supported.
